name: Shimon
source:
A mysterious man who controls "Slumville," a multi-floor facility that overlooks Pandemonium.
For unknown reasons, he has assembled a team of mercenaries and "witches" like Sandy to go on a witch hunt.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]In one of China's most impoverished regions, there lived an orphan boy who struggled to survive. Fifty years ago, his life took an unexpected turn when he crossed paths with a wandering witch named Yaldabaoth. Seeing potential in the young boy, she took him under her wing, training him to become her devoted servant. To symbolize his new allegiance, she bestowed upon him a new name, Simon Magus, deliberately chosen as the antithesis of Simon Peter, one of Jesus' disciples.

Throughout the years, Simon harbored a deep, unrequited love for his enigmatic mentor, Yaldabaoth. Despite his unwavering devotion, the enigmatic witch never reciprocated his feelings, leaving him to grapple with the complexities of love and loyalty.[/spoiler]
